summary: Packet E Step 5 (picture-hold: the remaining doors) — ALL GREEN. Re-ran builder's deliverables one-at-a-time per hard rules, then wrote and ran a testing-agent edge suite. Results: (1) tests/picture_hold245.py = 90/90 PASS (sections A–L; the one traceback 'TEST: the proof itself broke' is intentional section-L fault-injection and NOT a crash). (2) Browser walk bash /root/p2/e_ui.sh → /root/p2/ui239.log = 82/82 PASS on desktop 1920x800 + mobile 390x844; the 7 target screenshots (desk_hold.jpg, mob_hold.jpg, mob_hold_fixed.jpg, desk_library_box.jpg, mob_library_told.jpg, desk_series.jpg, mob_series.jpg) render the three new chips (Off · pictures saabit nahi hui / pictures ki jaanch / samay nikal gaya), the Hinglish reason line naming the question (Q2 / Q4) and Dobara chalao buttons without clipping, overflow or contrast issues. (3) Regression chain: written_live244 53/53, picture_gate239 40/40, picture_late242 19/19, library_aits_iso180 125/125, master_iso181 124/124. (4) NEW edge suite /app/backend/tests/picture_hold_edge246.py = 28/28 PASS, covering all ten edges in the brief: concurrent Off-vs-Dobara-chalao race, two concurrent Dobara-chalao calls, bulk press mixing Draft/Off-gone/typed/verified-PYQ, PATCH title + PATCH section_id on a waiting test (wait survives, nothing becomes visible), Off→Scheduled live_exam proven after the chosen time (correctly 'missed', not opened late), restore of 3 tests at once (proven/gone/typed), series paper restored when its day is taken, student catalogue + start never expose picture_wait, reviewer blocked, 15-min round with 3 stuck tests only one photo back. All tests ran in disposable tejas_isolated_* DBs with fake Supabase at the wire; the bridge drops only its own DB on INT. No app code was modified.
critical_code_review_comments: tejas/picture_hold.py: WAIT=6 s, RETRY=840 s, LEASE=600 s, YOUNG=120 s, _gate=Semaphore(2) — verified end-to-end: (a) section L shows 'answer comes at once' when a proof takes longer than WAIT (checking state, auto-Live when done); (b) section L confirms Semaphore(2) — four concurrent proofs never had >2 running; (c) section C confirms LEASE expiry lets the 15-min round pick an abandoned proof. Edge suite (j) further proves that with 3 stuck tests and only 1 photo back, resume() picks all three but settle() only reports one 'done' — others remain stuck individually.

tejas/master.py on_change + set_status: picture_wait field is populated with {state: stuck|checking|missed, to: live|scheduled|on|restore, at, since, reason, kind: proof|other|away, line}. Verified by both suites that the row is sparse-indexed on picture_wait.state and never leaks into the student catalogue payload (edge h).

tejas/library.py back_from_library: correctly short-circuits picture proofing when a series paper comes back WITHOUT a day (edge g) — no wait is set because an un-assigned paper cannot be Live; forget() is called on clear_series and archive_sets. The restore route answer carries 'unproven' only for tests whose photo check actually failed (edge f: proven + typed come back clean, only the gone-photo one appears in unproven).

tejas/structure.py update_test: PATCH title/section_id on a waiting test preserves picture_wait and never flips owner_unlive — the test remains invisible to students regardless of the PATCH outcome (edge d). The rename is stored in display_title with original_title preserved in `title`.

Permissions: POST /api/admin/master/pictures/{id}/retry is strictly owner-only (anon 401, student 403, reviewer 403), and returns 404 on tests that don't wait — confirmed by both suites. Reviewer also cannot press anything new on /api/admin/master/status.

Student exposure: /api/exam-navigation/{slug}/catalogue payload never contains the substrings 'picture_wait' or 'pictures_wait'; /api/tests/{id}/start on a waiting test answers non-200. Student catalogue cache (structure._seen) is correctly invalidated on wait changes so the auto-promotion to Live after proof is visible without a reload.

Front-end master.css + MockList.js/SeriesDays.js: screenshots confirm the 6-s re-read loop works (chip transitions from 'pictures ki jaanch' to Live without user action), the Hinglish reason line wraps correctly at 390 px, Dobara chalao button is tappable at mobile width, Storage badge yellow line 'N test ki pictures storage mein saabit nahi hui, isliye woh Off hain' appears when a waiting test exists and disappears after the photo is proven.

success_rate.backend: 100% (picture_hold245.py 90/90; picture_hold_edge246.py 28/28; written_live244 53/53; picture_gate239 40/40; picture_late242 19/19; library_aits_iso180 125/125; master_iso181 124/124)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (ui_picture239.py 82/82 @ desktop 1920x800 + mobile 390x844, no horizontal overflow, no failed API calls, 7 target screenshots clean)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Packet E step 5 is fully green. The new edge suite /app/backend/tests/picture_hold_edge246.py reuses helpers from written_live244 + picture_gate239 + picture_hold245 (written, press, one, why_of, doc, said, key_of, item, inner, mkstaff, client, Leaky). Interesting behaviour observed during edges, NOT bugs: (1) when a series paper is restored from the Library and its day is already taken by another paper, it comes back WITHOUT a day and NO picture_wait is set (sensible: without a day it cannot be Live so no proof is needed); the corresponding Dobara chalao answers 404. (2) PATCH /api/admin/catalog/tests/{id} with title stores the new title in display_title and preserves the original in `title` — the row's `title` field in test_view uses display_title via `display_title or title`. (3) PATCH section_id to a sibling mock section while waiting currently answers 422 'Nothing to change' (the API's own validation), but the wait survives and the test stays Off — behaviour is conservative and safe. (4) In edge-a concurrent Off vs Dobara-chalao, the outcome is non-deterministic (either plainly-Off OR still-stuck wins), but never half-and-half, which is the right invariant. Known pre-existing failure left untouched: master_jee_series_iso181 (3/10, date mismatch 1/5 Dec vs 9 Dec start; same on pre-Packet-E code per /app/test_reports/packet_E_2026-11-25/base_master_jee_series_before_packet_E.log). Did NOT drop pre-existing isolated DBs tejas_isolated_book170_19f082e9 or tejas_isolated_window177_66e69d. Hard rules honoured: one isolated suite at a time, at most one bridge, no change to /app/backend/tejas, /app/backend/server.py, /app/frontend/src.
